lessons.title: FTC Control System and App Roles

explain.title: Understanding FTC Control System and App Roles
explain.content: This lesson develops practical skill in FTC Control System and App Roles within 'FTC SDK Fundamentals'. Students apply Java-first thinking, then connect it to robotics execution and reliability.
keyPoints: Apply core Java concepts before FTC-specific abstractions
Use clear code structure and naming
Validate behavior through output or telemetry
Build toward competition-ready reliability

example.title: FTC Control System and App Roles Example

annotations.note: Initialize key values for control logic

exercise.title: Practice: FTC Control System and App Roles
exercise.instructions:
1. Recreate the example logic with your own variable names.
2. Modify one condition or value and predict output.
3. Run and compare expected vs actual behavior.
4. Add one readability or reliability improvement.

questions.question: Why do we front-load standard Java before deeper FTC SDK work?

options.text: To build stronger software foundations and reduce SDK confusion
Because FTC does not use Java

questions.question: What improves reliability in competition code?

options.text: Clear structure plus validation and fallback behavior
